test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A contractor is midway through a construction project and notices that the work is falling behind schedule. The client has emphasized that the building must meet all safety regulations and quality standards, even if completion is slightly delayed. Faced with pressure to deliver on time, what decision should the contractor make?

options.text: Use Cheaper Materials to Accelerate Work
Cut Corners on Safety Standards to Save Time

solution:
According to the given situation:

 
 

 Option
 Statement
 Correctness
 Reasoning
 
 
 
 

 1
 Use cheaper materials to accelerate work.
 Incorrect
 Using poor quality materials may reduce durability and compromise the overall quality of the project.
 
 

 2
 Compromise on non-critical aesthetics.
 Incorrect
 Although aesthetics may seem less important, unnecessary compromises can reduce client satisfaction and project value.
 
 

 3
 Incorporate quality control checks mid-project.
 Correct
 Incorporating mid-project quality control checks ensures the work stays compliant with safety and quality standards while identifying delays early, allowing corrective action without sacrificing integrity.
 
 

 4
 Cut corners on safety standards to save time.
 Incorrect
 Ignoring safety measures is highly irresponsible and can lead to accidents, legal issues, and project failure.
 
 

Qualities Projected in this situation: Responsibility, professionalism, quality management, and ethical decision-making.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
